messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "single high-dose fraction radiotherapy"
set: ["single high-dose fraction radiotherapy", "high-dose aspirin", "8 mg orally 1 to 2 hours before each fraction of radiotherapy administered each day", "150 mg single dose", "10 mg single dose", "no single gabapentin product", "nausea and vomiting associated with radiotherapy", "multi-dose KwikPen (for single patient use)", "patients without an ejection fraction less than 40%", "heart failure (NYHA Class III-IV) with reduced ejection fraction", "8 mg orally 1 to 2 hours before radiotherapy", "subsequent doses continue for each day radiotherapy is given", "single large dose not likely to cause life-threatening symptoms", "taken as a single dose or split into two doses", "these subsequent doses continue for 1 to 2 days after the completion of radiotherapy", "do not exceed the maximum single dose of 150 mg for immediate-release tablets"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
